parameters.text: Quiet Churn Desk Send me your sales register as an Excel file (Tally, Vyapar, Zoho or any export with customer, date and amount) and I will tell you which regular customers have quietly stopped ordering, what it is costing, and draft a message to win each one back. Type /scan to re-check the sales already saved in your Google Sheet. Every Monday at 9 am I run on my own.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 1024, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "You read the first rows of a sales export from an Indian small business (Tally, Vyapar, Zoho, Busy, Marg, Shopify or plain Excel) and work out which column holds what.
Use the header text EXACTLY as it appears. Never invent a column name. Use null for anything that is not there.
- customer_column: the buyer (party, customer, client, account name)
- date_column: the bill or order date
- amount_column: the bill value for that row. Prefer the gross or net total over tax, rate or quantity columns
- invoice_column: bill, voucher or order number
- phone_column: mobile or phone number
- items_column: item or product description
- type_column: a column that marks sales versus returns, credit notes or cancellations
- date_order: DMY, MDY or YMD. Indian exports are almost always DMY
Return ONLY JSON with keys customer_column, date_column, amount_column, invoice_column, phone_column, items_column, type_column, date_order, notes.

" + $json.sample_text }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "Below are pairs of customer names from ONE business's sales register that look alike.
For each pair decide: is it the SAME business written two ways (spelling, capitals, short forms like Bros or Trdrs, an added Store or Pvt Ltd), or two DIFFERENT businesses that happen to share words (two different Sharma shops, or the same shop name in two different areas)?
A shared phone number means almost certainly the same. Different phone numbers mean almost certainly different. A different area name usually means a different branch or shop.
When unsure, answer false. A wrong merge hides a lost customer.
Return ONLY JSON {"decisions":[{"id":"p1","same":true,"reason":"under 12 words"}]} with one entry per pair id. If the list says NONE return {"decisions":[]}.

PAIRS:
" + $json.pairs_text }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "You look at regular customers of an Indian distributor who have gone quiet, and suggest ONE likely reason for each, in plain English for a busy owner.
Read the pattern in the numbers:
- bills shrinking over the last few orders before stopping usually means they moved part of their buying to another supplier
- a sudden stop after steady full-size bills usually means something changed at once: a new supplier, a closure, a payment or delivery problem
- a long-standing customer going quiet deserves a personal call
Each customer comes with a pattern label in plain words. Build the reason from that label and the numbers.
Always write it as a possibility (may, might, possibly), never as a fact.
Write every reason differently: never start two reasons with the same words, and do not repeat a phrase across customers.
Use ONLY numbers that appear in the data. Never invent a percentage, amount, date or event. Under 25 words each. No em dash or en dash.
Return ONLY JSON {"reasons":[{"id":"c1","reason":"..."}]} with one entry per id.

CUSTOMERS:
" + $json.facts_text }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.8, maxOutputTokens: 3072, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "Write a short WhatsApp message that the owner will send personally to each regular customer who has gone quiet. The goal is a warm, natural check-in that makes it easy to order again.
Rules, all of them:
- Sound like the owner texting a customer they know, not like a company
- Follow the tone, words and language below. hinglish means natural Roman-script Hindi mixed with English, the way people text in India
- Open with the owner's greeting and the FIRST word of the shop name plus ji: Daga Kirana becomes Daga ji, Mathur Traders Malviya Nagar becomes Mathur ji. Never put ji after the full shop name
- Use the owner's favourite phrases where they fit, at most one per message, and never the same phrase in every message. Use the sign-off once at the end
- Questions end with a question mark
- Ask if all is well and offer to send stock. You may mention new stock in general words
- Never mention tracking, systems, data, records, or how many days they have been away
- No numbers of any kind. No guilt. No emojis. No em dash or en dash. Under 280 characters
- Follow the discount rule exactly
- Every message must read differently. Do not reuse the same opening or the same sentence
Return ONLY JSON {"messages":[{"id":"c1","message":"..."}]}.

" + 'OWNER TONE:
' + $json.tone_text + '

CUSTOMERS:
' + $json.writer_text }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 3072, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "You are the last check before a business owner sees these WhatsApp drafts.
REPAIR, do not rewrite: keep each draft as close to the original as possible and change only what breaks a rule.
Rules:
- under 280 characters
- no discount, offer, cashback or free item unless discounts are allowed below
- no guilt (you forgot us, why did you stop)
- nothing that sounds like surveillance (our system noticed, our records show, it has been so many days)
- nothing untrue or invented: no new product names, prices or dates
- no numbers, no emojis, no em dash or en dash
- must stay warm and in the owner's language
Return ONLY JSON {"checked":[{"id":"c1","message":"...","changes":["short note"]}]}. changes is an empty list when nothing needed fixing.

OWNER TONE AND RULES:
" + $('16 Fact Guard').first().json.tone_text + '

DRAFTS:
' + (($json.candidates && $json.candidates[0] && $json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) || '{"messages":[]}') }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4, maxOutputTokens: 1024, responseMimeType: 'application/json' }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "Write the owner's Monday brief: exactly five short lines in plain English, for someone reading on a phone between customers.
Line 1: how many regular customers have broken their usual ordering pattern.
Line 2: the rupees a year at risk, written as Rs with Indian commas and the words a year, for example Rs 4,20,000 a year.
Write natural sentences. Never copy a field label or write an underscore.
Line 3: who to call today, by name.
Line 4: who is seasonal and needs no action, or say nobody.
Line 5: one calm, practical nudge.
Use ONLY numbers given below. Do not calculate new ones and do not round. No emojis, no em dash or en dash.
Return ONLY JSON {"lines":["...","...","...","...","..."]}.

FACTS:
" + $('14 Judge Status, Season And Money').first().json.brief_text }] }] }) }}

parameters.text:
={{ 'I could not tell which columns are the customer, the date and the amount in this file, so I have not judged anything yet.

Columns I found: ' + ($json.headers || []).join(', ') + '
Dates readable: ' + $json.date_rate + '%  Amounts readable: ' + $json.amount_rate + '%

Please rename the three columns to Customer, Date and Amount, or send the sales register straight from Tally or Vyapar as an Excel file, and send it again.' }}

parameters.content:
## A · Intake
Monday schedule or a file dropped on Telegram. Button taps and /scan are routed here too.

## B · Understand
Agents read messy columns and names. Code decides what to trust.

## C · The maths (code only)
Usual gap, pattern break, seasonal guard, past decisions, rupees at risk.

## D · Agents explain and act
Reason, win-back message, message check, Monday brief. Every number is checked.

## E · Deliver
Google Sheet (feeds Data Studio), Telegram brief and cards, HTML email.
